errors.evidence: This information is derived from the paper's caption, not from the visual elements of the figure itself.
The right y-axis, labeled 'GPU Mem. Ratio (%)', visibly ranges from 40 to 100, not 0 to 100.
The tick marks on the right y-axis are at intervals of 10 units (40, 50, 60, etc.), not 20.
The perplexity line does not rise at the end. The value at a 90% ratio is approximately 4.39, and it slightly decreases to about 4.38 at a 100% ratio.
The 'GPU Mem. Ratio' line ends at a value very close to 100% when the recent sequence ratio is 100%. The value is approximately 99.5%, not 95%.
